run.question:
Alertmanager alert PendingPodsDetected (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/otel-demo since 2026-11-18T01:53:39Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert matches two pods in namespace otel-demo that are Pending because they cannot be scheduled: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh each carry spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}, and no node in the cluster has that hostname label, so the scheduler reports '4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'. Those pods were created at 01:52:42 and 01:52:50 by new ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5, which the Deployments ad and cart scaled up; both deployments' pod templates, and only those two of the 21 otel-demo deployments, now specify nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node (image digests unchanged at 2.1.3-ad / 2.1.3-cart, deployment revision 2), i.e. a configuration-only change to the two workloads. Both deployments still have one ready, restart-free replica from the pre-change ReplicaSets, and ad/cart span traffic continued through 02:08, so the observed consequence is a stuck rollout plus exactly two unschedulable pods; no frontend- or payment-level error impact was observed. No ConfigMap in the cluster holds this nodeSelector and all flagd fault flags remain 'off', so the setting appears to have been applied directly to the two Deployment specs; who applied it is not visible (change history is not integrated).

claims.text: In namespace otel-demo, 2 of the 23 pods are Pending with no node assigned: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; both have condition PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable, and the other 21 pods are Running and Ready.

The scheduler message on both pending pods is exactly: '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/5 nodes are available: 5 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.' (FailedScheduling, count 3 each, 01:52:42-02:03:05).
Both pending pods have spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}; the running sibling pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p have nodeSelector null.

The pod templates of Deployment ad and Deployment cart both specify nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}; of the 21 deployments in otel-demo these are the only two with any nodeSelector, all others have nodeSelector null.

None of the cluster's 5 nodes has kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node; the node hostnames are i-01a47734339426210 (control-plane, tainted node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule), i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 and i-097278082719f10ba, all Ready with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure False.

At 01:52:42 the deployment-controller scaled ReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 from 0 to 1 (Deployment ad) and that ReplicaSet created pod ad-dd7f45975-mw86p; at 01:52:50 it scaled ReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 from 0 to 1 (Deployment cart) and that ReplicaSet created pod cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh.

The new ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 (created 01:52:42) and cart-5b597c6db5 (created 01:52:50) have ready=null, while the previous ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 and cart-755465879b (created 01:15:16) still have ready=1.

Deployments ad and cart report revision annotation '2', generation 2, readyReplicas 1, availableReplicas 1 and unavailableReplicas 1, with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and :2.1.3-cart unchanged, which is consistent with a configuration-only template change rather than an image rollout.

The pre-change pods of both services are still running and ready with restartCount 0 (ad-554b849958-42mdm since 01:15:19, cart-755465879b-bgb2p since 01:15:27), and ad/cart span activity continued after 01:52: ad 1475.6 and cart 14042.2 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in 01:52:30-02:08:26, ad error spans 1.02 in that window versus 2.08 in 01:20:00-01:52:00 (same low background rate).

No frontend- or payment-level error rise accompanies the pending pods: STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase over 00:53:39-02:08:26 is 0 for frontend and 0 for payment, and frontend-proxy shows ~18 while ad/fraud-detection/recommendation show ~3 each, all stable across the window.

Node-level resource pressure or node outages were considered and rejected: all 5 nodes are Ready with no memory/disk/PID pressure, and the scheduler message names affinity/selector mismatch (plus the control-plane taint) rather than insufficient cpu/memory.

An application-level fault-injection flag was considered and rejected as the cause of the pending pods: in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config every flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, paymentFailure, etc.) still has defaultVariant 'off'.

A cluster-wide ConfigMap scan for the values 'invalid-node', 'nodeSelector' or 'hostname' matched only clickhouse and cilium configuration ConfigMaps, not any otel-demo object, so the nodeSelector setting is not held in a ConfigMap.

Cluster-wide event grouping over 01:37:06-02:03:52 shows the otel-demo impact as exactly Deployment/otel-demo ScalingReplicaSet x2, ReplicaSet/otel-demo SuccessfulCreate x2 and Pod/otel-demo FailedScheduling x2; there are no Evicted, OOMKilled, BackOff or Unhealthy events for otel-demo pods.

The invalid nodeSelector was applied to the pod templates of Deployments ad and cart as a deliberate configuration change shortly before 01:52:42, and the resulting ReplicaSets are the mechanism by which the two unschedulable pods were created; the identity of the actor/object that applied the patch is not visible in the available evidence.

Remove the nodeSelector key kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node from the pod templates of Deployments otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/cart (or point it at a real node hostname such as i-037e40963128cbd9f) via the owning Helm release, then delete the stuck ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5 so the pending pods can be replaced and the rollouts complete.

gaps: Who or what patched the pod templates of Deployments ad and cart (and the exact patch time, beyond the inferred 01:52:42/01:52:50 ReplicaSet creation) is unknown: the change_history integration is not available in this Run and Kubernetes events record no object-update event for these Deployments.
MutatingWebhookConfiguration reads failed twice with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so a webhook-based mutation of the Deployment templates could be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

The Helm release storage for release 'otel-demo' lives in Secrets, which cannot be read, so the release values/revision history that could show the ad/cart nodeSelector being introduced could not be verified.

A query for pods in namespace 'agent' (namespace created 01:51:06, labeled app.kubernetes.io/part-of: it-bench) returned no data (status no_data); whether an injection/access-provider workload exists there is unknown.

Pod, ReplicaSet and Deployment objects were read at 02:08-02:09, after the alert window, so their state earlier in the window is not directly proven; pod/replicaset creation timestamps and events are the only in-window timing evidence.
Pod/otel-demo FailedScheduling events existed only from 01:52:42, but events expire and earlier scheduling failures cannot be excluded.

Two FailedScheduling events exist for Pods in namespace data-recorders (02 events in the 01:37-02:03 event window); that namespace is outside the alert's scope and was not investigated, so whether those pods are still pending is unknown.
next_steps: Inspect cluster audit logs or the deployment pipeline that owns Helm release 'otel-demo' to identify the actor that set nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node on Deployments ad and cart at ~01:52.
Confirm via the Helm release values whether the ad and cart nodeSelector was committed to the chart values/environment overlay, and revert it there so it is not reapplied.
After the nodeSelector is corrected, verify that ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5 reach ready=1 and that the PendingPodsDetected alert resolves in namespace otel-demo.
